propositions: rebar must support s3://bucket/prefix as sync.remote value for ticket-store git history, with init/mount/create/claim/push/fetch operations succeeding and ticket data remaining encrypted at rest in the S3 bucket only

when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below minimum pinned version, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the exact pip install command

multiple concurrent or legacy pushes can leave two <sha>.bundle files for a single ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at multiple SHAs and fresh clones to fail; this state must self-heal non-interactively by merging divergent heads while preserving all commits and events
S3 backend configuration including optional [s3] dependency, minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket setup, CMK/IAM requirements, and sync.remote parameter must be documented for operator self-service
